arxiv-2104-12830.title: Traveling fronts for the generalized Fisher- KPP equation with non-local diffusion
arxiv-2104-12830.creator: José Fuentealba
arxiv-2104-12830.description: Abstract The aim of this paper is to study the generalized Fisher-KPP equation with non-local diffusion. In specific we prove the existence of a critical speed so that traveling front type solutions exist up to this critical speed and non-existence of traveling fronts below this critical value.

arxiv-2212-06161.title: Common envelope evolution and triple dynamics as potential pathways to form the inner white dwarf + brown dwarf binary of the triple star system Gaia 0007 − - 1605 2022 Common envelope evolution and triple dynamics as potential pathways to form the inner white dwarf + brown dwarf binary of the tripl
arxiv-2212-06161.creator: Felipe Lagos, Monica Zorotovic, Matthias R. Schreiber B. T. Gänsicke
arxiv-2212-06161.description: Abstract The recently discovered system Gaia 0007 − - 1605 consisting of a white dwarf with a close brown dwarf companion and a distant white dwarf tertiary very much resembles the triple system containing the first transiting planet candidate around a white dwarf ever discovered: WD 1856+534.

arxiv-2503-01064.title: Scientific Reasoning: Assessment of Multimodal Generative LLMs
arxiv-2503-01064.creator: Florian Dreyer, Ekaterina Kolos, Daria Matiash
arxiv-2503-01064.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) can answer questions and reason about complex tasks, also from the scientific domain. We assess several multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) on ScienceQA and find that Gemini models show the highest accuracy with little context, and the highest textual similarity to human explanations with richer context. Adapter-tuning of smaller MLLMs did not lead to any reliable performance.

arxiv-2506-22109.title: Exact BPS black hole microstate counting from holographic conformal quantum mechanics
arxiv-2506-22109.creator: Gabriel Lopes Cardoso 1 and Suresh Nampuri 2
arxiv-2506-22109.description: Abstract In this note, we develop a prescription for describing BPS black hole microstates in terms of a holographic conformal quantum mechanics (CQM) model dual to the near-horizon A ​ d ​ S 2 AdS_{2} geometry of the black hole.

arxiv-2508-11844.title: The BSN Application-I: Photometric Light Curve Solutions of Contact Binary Systems
arxiv-2508-11844.creator: Ehsan Paki, Atila Poro, Minoo Dokht Moosavi Rowzati
arxiv-2508-11844.description: Abstract Light curve analysis of W UMa-type contact binary systems using MCMC or MC methods can be time-consuming, primarily because the repeated generation of synthetic light curves tends to be relatively slow during the fitting process. Although various approaches have been proposed to address this issue, their implementation is often challenging due to complexity or uncertain performance.

arxiv-2509-16787.title: On the Ballistic Transport for limit-periodic Jacobi Matrices Thanks: R. Han and M.G. Solis were partially supported by NSF-DMS-2143369.
arxiv-2509-16787.creator: Rui Han, Moises Gomez Solis
arxiv-2509-16787.description: Abstract . Motivated by Open Problem 17 in Damanik-Fillman’s manuscript [ 2 ] , we study the decay rate of limit-periodic approximation such that ballistic transport persists in the limit-periodic setting. We show an exponential decay rate, roughly ‖ 𝒥 − 𝒥 q n ‖ ∼ e − η ​ q n \|\mathscr{J}-\mathscr{J}_{q_{n}}\|\sim e^{-\eta q_{n}} , is sufficient.

arxiv-2510-06270.title: MCCE: A Framework for Multi-LLM Collaborative Co-Evolution
arxiv-2510-06270.creator: Nian Ran, Zhongzheng Li, Yue Wang, Qingsong Ran, Xiaoyuan Zhang, Shikun Feng, Richard Allmendinger, Xiaoguang Zhao
arxiv-2510-06270.description: Abstract Multi-objective discrete optimization problems, such as molecular design, pose significant challenges due to their vast and unstructured combinatorial spaces. Traditional evolutionary algorithms often get trapped in local optima, while expert knowledge can provide crucial guidance for accelerating convergence. Large language models (LLMs) offer powerful priors and reasoning ability, making them natural optimizers when expert knowledge matters.

arxiv-2510-25952.title: Modular Linear Tokenization (MLT)
arxiv-2510-25952.creator: Tcharlies Schmitz
arxiv-2510-25952.description: Abstract Abstract. This paper introduces Modular Linear Tokenization (MLT), a reversible and deterministic technique for encoding high-cardinality categorical identifiers into compact numerical vectors. Unlike traditional hashing or one-hot encodings, MLT preserves bijective mappings by leveraging modular arithmetic over finite fields and invertible linear transformations.

arxiv-2512-24225.title: Entropic order parameters and topological holography
arxiv-2512-24225.creator: Hua-Chen Zhang, Germán Sierra, and Javier Molina-Vilaplana
arxiv-2512-24225.description: Abstract We show that the symmetry topological field theory (SymTFT) construction, also known as the topological holography, provides a natural and intuitive framework for the entropic order parameter characterising phases with (partially) broken symmetries. Various examples of group and non-invertible symmetries are studied.

arxiv-2601-01887.title: Safety at One Shot: Patching Fine-Tuned LLMs with A Single Instance
arxiv-2601-01887.creator: Jiawen Zhang, Lipeng He, Kejia Chen, Jian Lou, Jian Liu, Xiaohu Yang, Ruoxi Jia
arxiv-2601-01887.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Jiawen Zhang, Lipeng He, Kejia Chen, Jian Lou, Jian Liu, Xiaohu Yang, Ruoxi Jia. Fine-tuning safety-aligned large language models (LLMs) can substantially compromise their safety. Previous approaches require many safety samples or calibration sets, which not only incur significant computational overhead during realignment but also lead to noticeable degradation in model utility. Contrary to this belief, we show that safety alignment can be fully recovered with only a single safety example, without sacrificing utility and at minimal cost.

pmc-10505605.title: Extranodal lymphoma: pathogenesis, diagnosis and treatment
pmc-10505605.creator: Hua Yang, Yang Xun, Chao Ke, Kensuke Tateishi, Hua You
pmc-10505605.description: Approximately 30% of lymphomas occur outside the lymph nodes, spleen, or bone marrow, and the incidence of extranodal lymphoma has been rising in the past decade. While traditional chemotherapy and radiation therapy can improve survival outcomes for certain patients, the prognosis for extranodal lymphoma patients remains unsatisfactory.

pmc-10661387.title: Low-sugar egg-based dessert (sweet egg yolk drops): Characterization, consumer acceptance and driver of liking
pmc-10661387.creator: Phanlert Promsakha na Sakon Nakhon, Montakan Aimkaew, Saynamphung Tongsai, Wannarat Leesuksawat
pmc-10661387.description: The addition of sweeteners and fructooligosaccharides (FOS) to partially reduced-sugar syrup allows for the development of high-sugar egg-based desserts, which are a healthier alternative with good consumer acceptance. This study aimed to analyze the effects of different sweeteners and sugar reductions on physicochemical properties, consumer liking, and emotional responses of sweet egg yolk drops.

pmc-11289490.title: A multibranch and multiscale neural network based on semantic perception for multimodal medical image fusion
pmc-11289490.creator: Cong Lin, Yinjie Chen, Siling Feng, Mengxing Huang
pmc-11289490.description: Medical imaging is indispensable for accurate diagnosis and effective treatment, with modalities like MRI and CT providing diverse yet complementary information. Traditional image fusion methods, while essential in consolidating information from multiple modalities, often suffer from poor image quality and loss of crucial details due to inadequate handling of semantic information and limited feature extraction capabilities.

pmc-11692498.title: LONELY AND SOCIALLY DISCONNECTED OLDER ADULTS ARE AT HIGHER RISK FOR PREVALENT AND INCIDENT DEMENTIA
pmc-11692498.creator: Carmen Chek, Katherine Knauft, Ariana Stickel, Carlos Araujo-Menendez, Hector Gonzalez, Wassim Tarraf
pmc-11692498.description: A 2020 report from the National Academies indicates that nearly one in four adults over age 65 are lonely. Loneliness has important health implications, including for cognitive aging. However, loneliness might not manifest uniformly in the population. Herein, we address a gap in the existing literature by examining the link between heterogeneities in the risk of loneliness and dementia outcomes.

pmc-12604317.title: Trust in the healthcare system as a predictor of patient satisfaction: a cross-sectional survey in Türkiye’s primary care setting
pmc-12604317.creator: İbrahim Topuz, Mustafa Nal, Veli Durmuş, Gülfer Bektaş
pmc-12604317.description: BackgroundPatient satisfaction is a fundamental indicator of healthcare quality. However, while structural factors affecting satisfaction have been extensively studied in the literature, perceptions of the service process and the communication dimension have been relatively neglected. It offers concrete suggestions for developing strategies to increase trust in the health system, improve patient satisfaction, and achieve sustainable quality in health services.

pmc-13233246.title: A systematic evaluation of double-expressor lymphoma: prognostic impact, determinants of outcome, and comparative efficacy and safety of novel therapies
pmc-13233246.creator: Hao Guan, Zhihe Liu, Chengwen Gao, Wenqiu Wang, Kaiyue Liu, Xia Zhao
pmc-13233246.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundDouble-expressor lymphoma (DEL), defined by concurrent MYC and BCL2 protein overexpression in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL), is associated with poor prognosis, but precise risk quantification and optimal treatments remain unclear.MethodsWe conducted a two-stage evidence synthesis. First, a systematic review and meta-analysis quantified hazard ratios for progression-free survival (PFS) and overall survival (OS) comparing DEL with non-DEL and identified prognostic factors within DEL.

pmc-13356590.title: Pure Sertoli cell tumor of the right ovary managed with fertility-sparing surgery: a case report
pmc-13356590.creator: Yohannis Derbew Molla, Suleiman Ayalew Belay, Abebaw Muhabaw Zegeye, Samuel Addisu Abera, Endeshaw Asaye Kindie, Getachew Shiferaw Yigezaw
pmc-13356590.description: Sertoli cell tumors (SCTs) of the ovary are rare sex cord–stromal neoplasms. We describe a 37-year-old Ethiopian woman (G2P2) with six months of progressive lower abdominal pain but no virilization. Ultrasound revealed a solid 11 cm right adnexal mass. Hormonal profile was normal. An open fertility-sparing right salpingo-oophorectomy was performed. Histopathology confirmed a FIGO Stage IA well-differentiated pure SCT.

pmc-13377069.title: Quantifying groundwater storage dynamics during the 2024 flood season using GRACE-FO and multi-source hydrological data in Hunan Province, China
pmc-13377069.creator: Fan Lei, Jingwen Zhou, Kaijun Yang, Jide Wei, Li Cao, Fang Hu, Zhe Zhang, Yulong Zhong
pmc-13377069.description: Groundwater is a vital component of the hydrological cycle, and understanding its dynamics is crucial for water resource management under climate change. This study employs GRACE-FO satellite data to assess groundwater storage (GWS) dynamics in Hunan Province during the 2024 flood season (April-September).

pmc-13435509.title: Patterns of early-life microbial exposure and infection risk in hospital-born neonates in a tertiary hospital setting in Ghana
pmc-13435509.creator: Mary Fosuah, Ernest Osei, Cynthia Ayefoumi Adinortey, Dickson Kofi Wiredu Ocansey
pmc-13435509.description: BackgroundHospital environments serve as reservoirs of diverse airborne microorganisms, including fungi and multidrug-resistant bacteria, which pose serious risks to neonatal health. Although vernix caseosa provides initial protection against these microorganisms, neonates remain vulnerable to healthcare-associated infections due to their immature immune system and fragile protective barriers.

pmc-13525073.title: Clinical plausibility of eggshell membrane proteins for osteoarthritis: a study of solubility, digestibility, and immune response
pmc-13525073.creator: Simona Gegel, Arun Kumar, Lilia Goudeva, Jürgen Borlak
pmc-13525073.description: Supplements are commonly used by osteoarthritis (OA) patients, and eggshell membrane (ESM) proteins are widely advertised as natural bioactive compounds for joint health. Here, we evaluated the solubility, digestibility, and immunomodulatory potential of commercial ESM supplements under physiologically relevant conditions to assess their plausibility as anti-inflammatory agents.

uslaw-usc-t10-s9592.title: 10 U.S.C. § 9592 — Radiograms and telegrams: forwarding charges due connecting commercial facilities
uslaw-usc-t10-s9592.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s9592.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part IV (Service, Supply, And Procurement); Chapter 967 (Utilities And Services). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In the operation of telegraph lines, cables, or radio stations, members of the Air Force may, in the discretion of the Secretary of the Air Force, collect forwarding charges due connecting commercial telegraph or radio companies for sending radiograms.
